subject: website
name: Last Step
summary: Last Step, a read-only checker for finished but unclaimed staking and bridge withdrawals: one hand-written HTML page with a readable script and ethers 6.13.4 byte-identical to the official build, served as written, so its source is public (no licence file). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it loads Google Fonts and reads Ethereum through public RPC nodes, Blockscout and Etherscan.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.

connections.name: Public Ethereum RPC nodes (ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com and others)
connections.note: Chain reads when the page opens, without a light client.

connections.name: Blockscout and Etherscan APIs
connections.note: Queried with the pasted address when Check is pressed.
